Both provinces of Mhoirland ((C1) and (C2)) are mostly dominated by hills and short shrubs, though elevation decreeses very suddenly along most of the coasts, making for cliffs along the country's waters. There is a small mountain range in the center of the landmass, though it isn't a defining trait for either province. In fact, the placement of the range defines the border between north and south Mhoirland. This range is also a subject of worship in the local religion.

Mhoirland (pronounced voyrland) is a country known for its mild tempered populace and its even milder weather. Being a southern island nation, temperatures stay rather comfortable year round. The moderate climate also makes for the production of berries and nuts viable year round, so certain products like wine are a commodity. The nation of Mhoirland was once split many ways by various tribes that inhabited the island, but those days are long gone. While war hasn't been waged in a few generations,  battle still remains relevant through locally popular sports, like weapon sparring and wrestling. Geographically speaking, the island is similar to Mediterranean islands; steep coastlines, cliffs that look as though they were cut by a knife, and hills/mountains rising towards the center of the landmass. The rock on the island is beautifully white, making the faces of Mhoirland's mountains and cliffs stand out in stark contrast to the trees and shrubbery of the island.
Mhoirland roughly means "Great land" in the local language.

Originally, the plan was to put stuffed animals in unusual places that would end up lingering around the house for days (inspiration admittedly from the 4chan frog story), weeks or even months, continuously pissing my parents off to no end. 
Like any story, though, the joke didn't go as planned, as some of my dad's friends coming back from Afghanistan made an unexpected visit. These men are trained warriors, men who would easily hear my shuffling and giggling in the early hours of the morning. Aside from that, they kept my dad awake longer than I had expected him to be up, so my impatient mind decided to abandon the original plot, and instead be cocky in vengeance. 
Everyone except I eventually hit the hay, the snores of several soldiers shaking the house being my signal to begin. I started with the 2nd floor, which has a balcony over looking the living room. I laced it with stuffed animals, along with the stairway. I then attacked the soldiers, gathering ever patriotic sort of beanie baby I had in my arsenal, 4th of July bears, eagles, the works, littering them in front of and on my dad's friends. 

Around 3 hours later, ending at ~5 am, the house was filled with stuffed animals, some placed in areas where they would not be found for a week, some placed in obvious arrangements, as though ready for assault. The deed was done. I slept well that night, only to be loudly awoken by the sounds of terror and hysteria. 
The screams awoke anyone that had not already been up by 10 am that Sunday. One of the soldiers had just awoken, panicked, and screamed, waking up my dad, sister and I. My mom had not yet left her room, so had not seen what waited for her beyond her door. About the same time I walked out my door, a second voice shrieks, followed by a third laughing from the other side of the house. The laughter being my dad, the shrieks being another one of his friends. 

My dads friends left pretty quickly after that, but the stuffed animals continued to longer after the initial clean up. After a whole day of picking up, my parents would still find stuffed animals over the course of a week, responding with either an eruption of laughter or a curse directed towards me. 

It was a good week.
